tests.test_purpose: Price effect alone must not create scope relevance or force an RFQ decision/default.
tests.dependency: Prompt text / scenario harness / observed v1.0.2 defect
tests.setup: Recreate the residual reasoning failure observed in fresh live v1.0.3 Cee-purlin RFQ testing.
tests.input: An optional/common feature is absent from project evidence but would affect price if selected.
tests.expected_result: Do not ask, specify, exclude, alternate or default the feature merely because price changes. With no project/governing basis or unavoidable technical need, omit it.
tests.actual_result: v1.0.4 explicitly says common options, usefulness, risk or price impact alone are not basis; absence is not ambiguity; without basis, omit and do not choose an option.
tests.evidence: v1.0.4 scope-trigger text plus deterministic decision harness.
tests.release_consequence: Permanent regression coverage for DEF-SCOPE-001/002 at scenario level; live v1.0.4 runtime retest remains required.

tests.test_purpose: An absent optional feature must not be turned into a required decision by auto-selecting a default.
tests.dependency: Prompt text / deterministic harness / observed live v1.0.3 defect
tests.setup: Model an RFQ review where an optional feature has no project basis and the answer could try to resolve absence by declaring one option.
tests.input: No project source mentions punching; the model could say either specify unpunched or provide a punch schedule.
tests.expected_result: Treat absence as non-ambiguous. Do not force a decision or choose a default; omit the feature unless a real scope trigger exists or an assumption is strictly needed to complete the task.
tests.actual_result: v1.0.4 states absence is not ambiguity and, with no basis, to omit and not choose an option.
tests.evidence: v1.0.4 scope-trigger text; deterministic harness returns OMIT for an absent option with no basis.
tests.release_consequence: Permanent regression coverage for DEF-SCOPE-002; live runtime retest still required.

tests.test_purpose: Strengthened scope control must still allow a necessary working assumption when task completion otherwise stalls.
tests.setup: No scope trigger exists, but the requested task cannot reasonably be completed without a bounded assumption.
tests.input: A non-scope detail is missing and an explicit working assumption is necessary to calculate or draft the requested result.
tests.expected_result: State a bounded assumption and proceed; do not convert it into new scope or a needless clarification.
tests.actual_result: Deterministic harness returns ASSUME only when assumption_required=true; otherwise untriggered items are omitted.
tests.evidence: v1.0.4 scope text and deterministic decision harness.
tests.release_consequence: Confirms the correction does not suppress necessary assumption behavior.

defect_history.evidence_source: Fresh live ChatGPT Custom Instructions pilot supplied by the user using the personal v1.0.2 block
defect_history.observed_behavior: The RFQ response explicitly asked to confirm plain/unpunched versus factory-punched Cee purlins, requested punching details, and listed punching among items not to issue the RFQ without confirming, despite no drawing/specification/customer/mounting basis.
defect_history.root_cause: Materiality was evaluated before scope relevance. Because punching could affect price, the model treated it as clarification-worthy even though no project/governing evidence or technical/functional need made punching relevant.
defect_history.correction: v1.0.3 adds a basis gate before materiality: common/optional possibilities are not gaps; clarification requires project/governing basis or technical/functional need and material consequence.

defect_history.evidence_source: Fresh live ChatGPT Custom Instructions Cee-purlin RFQ response supplied by the user
defect_history.observed_behavior: The response no longer merely asked whether punching applied; it still promoted punching into an explicit RFQ decision, saying to specify unpunched or provide a punching drawing, and carried punching into pricing/scope language despite no project basis.
defect_history.root_cause: The v1.0.3 project/governing/technical basis wording was still broad enough for price/fabrication relevance to be treated as a technical need, and it did not explicitly say that absence is not ambiguity or that an untriggered option should be omitted rather than defaulted.
defect_history.correction: v1.0.4: industry practice/common options/usefulness/risk/price impact alone are not basis; absence is not ambiguity; with no basis, omit and do not choose an option unless task completion truly requires an assumption.
